finalSourceFreeze.scope: Isolated staged source only. No application to the actual repository is performed by this report.

ui.conditions: Actual controller in an event-capable DOM fixture. Lifecycle and admission probes mostly inject a privately branded stub. The explicit integration case uses the actual native/WASM parser, private copy helper and prepare guard. Actual layout and GPU proof comes from the browser.

browser.executionOwner: Root exclusively executed the actual HTTP/Chrome proof. The UI agent started no network/browser process and only read the receipts and personally viewed screenshots.

legacyBrowserStatus: No old browser rerun is counted here. Root-managed subsequent actual runs will be recorded in a separate web-legacy-addendum.json without replacing this report.

independentQuality.scope: Eight shared portable-source groups plus seven independent source/protocol/brand groups. These overlap core/prepared/UI verification and are not additive unique coverage.

retainedAttempts.scope: Initial forty injected new GUI cases plus three catalogue cases. Fresh native integration and old distribution regression are not claimed in this early run; the final82 includes them.

limits: All proof runs use the isolated stage and temporary author workspaces. actualApply:false means the actual repository remains unapplied; genuine source-memory Apply and ordinary Save in temporary workspaces are separately verified.

Each explicitly selected source creates one fresh UUID per dialog, stable through query, offset, repeated review and deselect/reselect. Zero offset is a structural change. Clone names retain original raw values without suffixes; originals and other scene fields remain intact.

The scene budget is128 total objects. This batch maximum is min(originalCount,128-originalCount), at most64 successful copies. Remaining slots alone do not imply the same number of eligible copies; excess selection is visibly blocked rather than truncated.
Common XYZ offsets are computed by native atomic semantics. The GUI does not calculate authored copy geometry. Any clone-bound, identity or full-source budget failure rejects the entire operation.
Global selection includes filtered-out objects. Silent checkbox, mapping dataset/text, query/offset intent, source/token changes, obsolete rows and late responses cannot replay approval.

Original private proposals pass unchanged to memory application. No sibling controller, renderer, World, HTTP, backend or Save port is imported by the copy controller. Ordinary Save and conflict decisions remain with the main editor.
UI, core, independent, prepared, browser and application scopes overlap and are not combined as unique coverage. No whole-application result is claimed by this web summary.
Real WebGL readPixels uses recorded SwiftShader software rendering. No installed app, Android/device or hardware-GPU acceptance is claimed.
